etoshaomusatilodge.lead: Bungalows and bush chalets near Etosha — a comfortable base for guided half- and full-day Etosha game excursions, with a campsite too.

hakusembecamping2go.name: Hakusembe Camping2Go

driftinnbayetecollection.lead: Value lodge in the Bayete Collection, Victoria Falls. USD, per person per night, B&B. Low 1 Jan-31 Mar / High 1 Apr-31 Dec.

phezulubayetecollection.lead: Bayete Collection lodge, Victoria Falls. USD, per person per night, B&B. Low 1 Jan-31 Mar / High 1 Apr-31 Dec.

bayeteguestlodge.lead: Flagship of the Bayete Collection, Victoria Falls. USD, per person per night, B&B. Low 1 Jan-31 Mar / High 1 Apr-31 Dec.

nkosibayetecollection.lead: Premium lodge in the Bayete Collection, Victoria Falls. USD, per person per night, B&B. Low 1 Jan-31 Mar / High 1 Apr-31 Dec.

pioneersvictoriafalls.lead: Victoria Falls lodge. USD, per person per night, B&B. Seasons: Jan-May, Jun-Oct, Nov-Dec.

thevictorianmanorbayetecollection.lead: The Victorian Manor — exclusive-use villa in the Bayete Collection, Victoria Falls. USD.

chobegamelodge.name: Chobe Game Lodge
chobegamelodge.lead: The only lodge inside Chobe National Park on the riverfront — game drives and river cruises straight from the door. Open all year.

chobesavannalodge.name: Chobe Savanna Lodge
chobesavannalodge.lead: On the Namibian bank looking across the Chobe floodplains — water-based game viewing and total quiet. Closed 1 Oct 2025 – 8 May 2026.

savutesafarilodge.name: Savute Safari Lodge
savutesafarilodge.lead: Overlooking the Savute Channel in Chobe National Park — predators, elephant and big open country. Closed 1 – 14 Feb.

campokavango.name: Camp Okavango
campokavango.lead: A classic water camp deep in the permanent Delta — mokoro, boating and island walks. Closed 14 Feb – 1 Mar.

xuganaislandlodge.name: Xugana Island Lodge
xuganaislandlodge.lead: On a permanent lagoon in the heart of the Delta — fishing, boating and birdlife. Closed 31 Jan – 13 Feb.

nxamaseriislandlodge.name: Nxamaseri Island Lodge
nxamaseriislandlodge.lead: Panhandle island lodge known for tigerfish, birding and the Tsodilo Hills rock art. Closed 15 Jan – 1 Feb.

campmoremi.name: Camp Moremi
campmoremi.lead: Under a riverine forest on Xakanaxa Lagoon in Moremi — game drives and Delta boating combined. Closed 31 Jan – 13 Feb.

campxakanaxa.name: Camp Xakanaxa
campxakanaxa.lead: One of Moremi's original camps on the Xakanaxa Lagoon — permanent water and year-round game. Closed 14 Feb – 1 Mar.

sedibasarona.name: Sediba Sa Rona
sedibasarona.lead: New for 2026 — Desert & Delta's Khwai Concession camp, on the common circuit rate structure. Closed 1 Jan – 15 Mar 2026.

leroolatau.name: Leroo La Tau
leroolatau.lead: Above the Boteti River on the edge of Makgadikgadi Pans — zebra migration and pans sleep-outs. Closed 15 Jan – 1 Feb.

livingdesertadventures.name: Living Desert Adventures
livingdesertadventures.lead: The original “Little 5” Living Desert Tour — half-day 4x4 dune ecology tour from Swakopmund. 15% STO, valid 1 Jan – 31 Dec 2027. Dorob park fees included.
